parameters.content:
## Who is this for?
Agencies turning client briefs into Lindo websites with an accountable approval and handoff process.

## How it works
A password-protected form captures a brief and readiness acknowledgement. A separate email asks the configured account manager to approve or reject the public website build. Rejection or a two-day expiry sends a no-build notice. Only explicit approval starts one Lindo creation request. Bounded polling distinguishes completion, partial results, errors and deadlines. The workflow archives a Markdown handoff document in private Google Drive, then emails its link and the build outcome. The document includes the original brief and a human QA checklist.

## Setup
1. Connect Form Basic Auth and SMTP on all email nodes.
2. Add Lindo Header Auth to both Lindo HTTP nodes: Authorization, Bearer YOUR_LINDO_API_KEY.
3. Set sender, reviewer, private Drive folder and maxPolls in Configure intake; connect Google Drive OAuth.
4. Test approval and rejection, then activate the form. Approval/wait callbacks require a reachable n8n URL.

## Requirements and customization
Uses built-in nodes; requires Lindo credits, SMTP and Drive. Approval spends credits and creates a public website. Duplicate form submissions are separate builds. Never restart the paid POST to recover a later failure; use the recorded workflow ID. The default polling budget is about ten minutes. Adjust the review checklist or approval window to your agency process. Keep the handoff private; build completion does not replace client acceptance.

parameters.content: Create HTTP Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_LINDO_API_KEY. Select it only in Lindo nodes. Configure Form Basic Auth, SMTP on all three email nodes and Google Drive OAuth. Use a private folder. The reviewer is fixed in Configure intake; form callers cannot choose it. Approval links are sensitive bearer links: keep the mailbox private.

The paid POST happens only after the separate manager approval. It has no automatic retry. Reject/timeout creates no site. Duplicate submissions are not deduplicated. If a later step fails, resume from the saved workflow ID rather than restarting creation. Partial, errored and timed-out builds are recorded honestly.

The Wait loop checks every 30 seconds, up to maxPolls (default 20). A polling timeout does not cancel Lindo. The Markdown handoff includes the approved brief, exact outcome and a QA checklist. Google Drive sharing is unchanged; only staff with existing folder access can open it.
